title: The Rust Programming Language
summary: The official book-length introduction to Rust: ownership and borrowing, traits, pattern matching, error handling, and fearless concurrency, with runnable examples throughout.

title: A Tour of Go
summary: An interactive, browser-based walkthrough of Go's syntax, methods, interfaces, goroutines, and channels. Ends with small concurrency exercises you complete in place.

title: The Python Tutorial
summary: The official language tour: data structures, functions, modules, classes, iterators, and the standard library. The fastest path to reading and writing real Python.

title: FastAPI User Guide
summary: A step-by-step build of a typed JSON API: path and query params, request bodies with Pydantic, dependency injection, authentication, and async database access.

title: SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM Quickstart
summary: Declarative models, sessions, relationships, and the 2.0 select() query style. Explains the unit-of-work pattern and how flush and commit differ.

title: React: Learn
summary: The modern React docs built around hooks: components, props, state, effects, and thinking in terms of data flow. Each section ends with interactive challenges.

title: Docker: Get Started
summary: Build an image, run a container, use volumes and networks, and push to a registry. Finishes with a multi-container app defined in Compose.

title: Learn Kubernetes Basics
summary: An interactive tutorial covering pods, deployments, services, scaling, and rolling updates against a live in-browser cluster.

title: PostgreSQL Tutorial (official documentation)
summary: The official getting-started chapters: creating tables, querying with joins and aggregates, views, transactions, foreign keys, and window functions.

title: Terraform Tutorials
summary: Guided labs for provisioning real cloud infrastructure: providers, state, input and output variables, modules, and remote backends, with AWS, Azure, and GCP tracks.

title: Apache Kafka Documentation
summary: The reference for Kafka's design: topics, partitions, consumer groups, delivery semantics, log compaction, and the Streams and Connect APIs.

title: Django: Writing Your First App
summary: The multi-part official tutorial: models and migrations, the admin site, views and templates, forms, and testing, built around a small polls application.

title: MDN: Learn CSS
summary: Box model, selectors, the cascade, flexbox, grid, and responsive design explained with editable examples. The reference most front-end developers return to.

title: 10 Minutes to pandas
summary: A fast tour of DataFrame and Series basics: selection, filtering, group-by, joins, missing data, and time series. A launching point into the fuller user guide.

title: PyTorch: Learn the Basics
summary: Tensors, datasets and dataloaders, autograd, building an nn.Module, and a complete training and evaluation loop for an image classifier.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
summary: The reference on replication, partitioning, transactions, consistency models, and stream processing, with the engineering trade-offs behind every modern data store.

title: The Go Programming Language
summary: A thorough, example-driven treatment of Go: types, methods, interfaces, goroutines, channels, reflection, and testing, from two veteran systems authors.

title: Fluent Python, 2nd Edition
summary: How Python actually works: the data model, sequences, dict internals, closures, decorators, type hints, and async. Turns competent Python into idiomatic Python.

title: Effective TypeScript
summary: Sixty-two focused items on structural typing, narrowing, generics, and configuring the compiler for real projects. Fixes the mistakes teams make after adopting TypeScript.

title: Pro Git, 2nd Edition
summary: The official Git book: the object model, branching and merging, rebasing, remotes, hooks, and recovering from mistakes. Free online in full.

title: Architecture Patterns with Python
summary: Repository, unit-of-work, service layer, domain events, and CQRS applied to a Python codebase with tests at every step. Free to read online.

title: Grokking Algorithms, 2nd Edition
summary: An illustrated introduction to binary search, sorting, recursion, hashing, graphs, dynamic programming, and greedy algorithms, with Python implementations.

title: Site Reliability Engineering
summary: How Google runs production systems: SLOs and error budgets, on-call, incident response, release engineering, and eliminating toil. Free online in full.

title: Database Internals
summary: How storage engines and distributed databases work under the hood: B-trees and LSM-trees, write-ahead logs, consensus, and replication protocols.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer, 20th Anniversary Edition
summary: Durable advice on decoupling, orthogonality, defensive coding, testing, and automation. A career-shaping read on how to think about software craft.

title: Fundamentals of Software Architecture
summary: Architecture styles from layered to event-driven and microservices, how to measure architectural characteristics, and the trade-off analysis the role demands.

title: Rust for Rustaceans
summary: Intermediate Rust: lifetimes and variance, trait objects, unsafe code, FFI, async internals, and testing. Picks up where the official Rust book leaves off.

title: Machine Learning Specialization
summary: Linear and logistic regression, neural networks, decision trees, and practical advice on bias, variance, and ML system design. Audit free; certificate paid.

title: Deep Learning Specialization
summary: Five courses covering dense networks, optimization, CNNs, sequence models, and how to structure ML projects. Programming assignments in Python and TensorFlow.

title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
summary: A top-down course: train and deploy a working model in the first lesson, then work down to the fundamentals of SGD, architectures, and training dynamics.

title: Full Stack Open
summary: Builds a modern JavaScript stack end to end: React with hooks, Redux, Node and Express REST APIs, testing, TypeScript, and GraphQL. Free, with an optional credit exam.

title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
summary: Harvard's intro to computer science: memory, data structures, and algorithms in C, then Python, SQL, and web basics. Problem sets are demanding and thorough.

title: Docker Mastery
summary: Images, containers, volumes, networking, Compose, Swarm, and an introduction to Kubernetes, with an emphasis on real development and CI workflows.

title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03)
summary: Full coverage of the SAA-C03 blueprint: EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, load balancing, and well-architected design, with hands-on labs and practice exams.

title: Test-Driven Development with FastAPI and Docker
summary: Builds and deploys an async FastAPI service test-first: pytest, Postgres, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions CI, and deployment to a managed cloud host.

title: Learn Next.js
summary: The official interactive course: the App Router, server and client components, data fetching, mutations, streaming, and deploying a dashboard application.

title: Functional Programming Principles in Scala
summary: Recursion, higher-order functions, immutable data structures, pattern matching, and lazy evaluation, taught by the creator of Scala. Audit free.

title: dbt Fundamentals
summary: Models, refs, sources, tests, documentation, and deployment in dbt against a cloud warehouse. The official on-ramp to analytics engineering.

title: Python Full Course for Beginners
summary: A single-sitting introduction to Python syntax, data types, control flow, functions, and several small programs. A common first exposure to the language.

title: SQL Full Course for Beginners
summary: Covers SELECT, joins, aggregation, subqueries, and schema design by building and querying a company database from scratch.

title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners
summary: A long-form tour of Kubernetes concepts with hands-on demos: architecture, kubectl, deployments, services, ConfigMaps, secrets, and a first Helm chart.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms (full course)
summary: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, priority queues, union-find, balanced trees, and graph traversals, each explained and then implemented.

title: Git and GitHub for Beginners: Crash Course
summary: Init, staging, commits, branches, merges, remotes, pull requests, and resolving conflicts, from the command line and on GitHub.

title: Node.js and Express.js Full Course
summary: Node fundamentals and the HTTP module, then Express routing, middleware, and a full REST API backed by a database.

title: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
summary: Builds micrograd, makemore, and a small GPT from scratch in PyTorch, deriving backpropagation and transformer internals line by line.

title: The Twelve-Factor App
summary: Twelve principles for portable, scalable web services: config in the environment, stateless processes, disposability, log streams, and dev/prod parity.

title: The Amazon Builders' Library
summary: Short, practical papers from AWS principal engineers on timeouts and retries, load shedding, health checks, and distributed-system failure modes.

title: Microservices
summary: The essay that defined the term: the style's characteristics, when it pays off, and the operational cost it trades for independent deployability.

title: Google Engineering Practices: Code Review
summary: What reviewers should look for, how quickly to respond, how to phrase review comments, and how authors should handle disagreement.

title: OWASP Top 10
summary: The ten most critical web application risks with concrete examples and prevention guidance: broken access control, injection, SSRF, and more.

title: Patterns for Building LLM-based Systems and Products
summary: A survey of practical patterns for shipping LLM features: evals, retrieval-augmented generation, caching, guardrails, defensive UX, and collecting feedback.

title: Build an in-memory key-value store
summary: Implement GET/SET/DEL with TTL and LRU eviction, then add a write-ahead log and a background compactor. Benchmark the read path against Redis for a subset of commands.

title: Build a REST API with FastAPI and PostgreSQL
summary: Model a domain with SQLAlchemy, add Alembic migrations, JWT auth, pagination, and pytest coverage, then containerize the service with Docker Compose.

title: Build a retrieval-augmented assistant over your own documents
summary: Chunk and embed a document set, store vectors in Postgres with pgvector, and answer questions with citations. Add an evaluation set to measure retrieval quality.

title: Build a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
summary: Run lint, type-check, and tests on every push, build and push a Docker image on tags, and deploy on green using environment protection rules.

title: Build an ETL pipeline with Airflow
summary: Schedule a DAG that extracts from an API, loads raw data to a warehouse, and runs dbt models, with retries, backfills, and data-quality checks.

title: Build a React analytics dashboard
summary: Fetch a paginated API, render sortable tables and charts, add client-side filtering and a date-range picker, and cover the components with tests.

title: Build a URL shortener
summary: Design the short-code encoding, put a cache in front of the database, add rate limiting and click analytics, and load-test the redirect path.
